const STATIC_ASSET_RE =
  /\.(?:png|jpe?g|gif|webp|avif|svg|ico|mp4|webm|woff2?|css|json|txt|md|html)$/i;

/**
 * Reachable on every host regardless of portal mode: Next internals, the API
 * surface every portal's own client code calls (chat SSE, uploads, etc.),
 * the auth utility pages every login form links to, and static files under
 * public/. Everything else is scoped to exactly one portal below.
 */
function isUniversallyAllowed(pathname: string): boolean {
  return (
    pathname.startsWith("/_next") ||
    pathname.startsWith("/api/") ||
    pathname === "/favicon.ico" ||
    pathname.startsWith("/.well-known/") ||
    pathname === "/forgot-password" ||
    pathname === "/reset-password" ||
    // Both portal layouts redirect a staff/admin account without 2FA here to
    // enroll (enforce_staff_2fa) -- account security settings aren't
    // customer-specific, and blocking this would stand between a legitimate
    // staff member and the one page that lets them satisfy the requirement.
    pathname === "/dashboard/settings" ||
    STATIC_ASSET_RE.test(pathname) ||
    // public/ also ships two vendored JS trees the portals load at runtime: the
    // noVNC console client (admin impersonation / VNC console) and skinview3d.

# Edit files on the primary as usual (your own git worktree — never /opt/nxeon),

# command inside the capped nxeon-build-agents.slice with a THROWAWAY database
# (Postgres on node-2 127.0.0.1:5433), and streams the output back.
#
#   scripts/devhost run [--lock] [--max SEC] -- CMD...   push + run CMD in the node-2 copy
#   scripts/devhost tsc                                  = run -- npx tsc --noEmit
#   scripts/devhost test [FILES...]                      = run --lock -- npx tsx --test ...
#   scripts/devhost build                                = run --lock -- npx next build
#   scripts/devhost dev [--port P]                       start `next dev` on node-2 (background unit)
#   scripts/devhost bg NAME [--port P] -- CMD...         any background process (worker, preview server)
#   scripts/devhost stop [NAME|all]                      stop this worktree's background units
#   scripts/devhost logs [NAME] [-n N] [-f]              journal of a background unit (default: dev)
#   scripts/devhost tunnel PORT [LOCAL_PORT]             ssh -L so the primary can curl/Playwright it
#   scripts/devhost pull REMOTE_PATH [LOCAL_DEST]        copy results (screenshots, reports) back
#   scripts/devhost push                                 just sync files (run does this itself)
#   scripts/devhost install                              force npm install + prisma generate there
#   scripts/devhost db push|reset|info                   throwaway DB: schema push / recreate / name
#   scripts/devhost env set KEY=VALUE | unset KEY | list extra env for this worktree (never prod secrets)
#   scripts/devhost rm                                   stop units, drop the throwaway DB, delete the node-2 copy
#   scripts/devhost ls | status | sync                   workspaces / node-2 load / push refs to node-2's mirror
#

version** every partner sees. Code: `lib/partner-kits.ts` (listing, grouping, guide parser, zip),
`lib/partner-kit-access.ts` (auth), `lib/partner-kit-urls.ts`, `components/nx/PartnerMediaKit.tsx`,
routes `app/api/creator-partner/kits/[code]/[file]/route.ts` (one file) and
`app/api/creator-partner/kits/[code]/route.ts` (the whole kit as a zip); test
`test/partner-kits.test.ts`.
- **Folder layout** (under `NXEON_PARTNER_FILES_DIR`, default `/opt/nxeon/partner-files/`, outside
  the repo/build — same dir as the PDFs above):
  ```
  partner-files/kits/<CODE>/      one folder per ReferralPartner.code, UPPERCASE, ^[A-Z0-9-]{2,20}$
  partner-files/kits/_generic/    shown to every partner
  ```
- **Naming convention** (what groups a video with its end frame and labels the language):
  `nxeon-promo_<CODE>_<lang>_16x9.mp4` + `nxeon-promo_<CODE>_<lang>_16x9_endframe.png` (the PNG is
  the player's poster and a download; optional) + one `HOW-TO-USE.txt`. Languages are labelled from
  the tag (`en` English, `tr` Turkish, `tl` Filipino (Tagalog), `es` Spanish, `hi` Hindi, others in
  `KIT_LANGUAGES`); English is listed first. The generic folder uses `GENERIC` as the code. Allowed
  extensions: mp4/webm/mov, png/jpg/webp, txt, pdf; anything else, dotfiles, symlinks and
  subfolders are ignored (never listed, never served). A file that matches no pattern is still
  offered under "Other files".
- **HOW-TO-USE.txt** is parsed (not dumped): title + `====` underline, then column-0 headings with
  indented bodies — "Your files" (`- name` list + optional prose), "What it is", "How to use it"
  (numbered steps), "Suggested narration (…)" (`0:00  text` lines; wrapped lines continue the
  previous one), "Description text" (shown in a box with a Copy button), "Questions: <email>".
  Unknown sections are still shown. The raw file stays downloadable. In the generic guide the
  placeholder `YOURCODE` is replaced with the viewing partner's real code on screen (the download
  is unchanged).
- **Publishing a creator's kit is a file copy, no deploy** (the page reads the folder on every load):
  ```
  install -d -o nxeon -g nxeon -m 0755 /opt/nxeon/partner-files/kits/<CODE>
  install -o nxeon -g nxeon -m 0644 <files…> /opt/nxeon/partner-files/kits/<CODE>/
  ```
  Replacing a file = copying over it. Removing the folder hides the block (the partner then sees
  only the generic version, with a line saying their own is on the way). A folder with no video
  shows nothing.
- **Auth** (`kitAccess`): signed out = 401; a signed-in partner gets only their OWN code's folder and
  `_generic`; billing-area staff (ADMIN, BILLING — the same gate as `/admin/partners/<id>`) get any
  folder; everyone else, any other code, and any name not in the folder listing = 404 (never 403, so
  the URL space isn't advertised). `currentUser()` follows impersonation, so an admin impersonating a
  partner sees exactly that partner's files. The file name must exactly match a whitelisted entry
  of the directory listing — no path is ever built from the URL alone (`..`, encoded separators and
  absolute paths are refused). Responses: correct content type, `inline` (player/preview) or
  `attachment` with `?download=1`, single HTTP Range (`bytes=a-b`, `a-`, `-n`; 416 past the end) so
  the in-page player can seek, `HEAD`, `private, no-store`, `nosniff`, `default-src 'none'; sandbox`.
  The zip is STORE-only (videos don't compress), streamed with an exact Content-Length (CRCs are
  computed first and cached per file size+mtime).
- **Admin**: `/admin/partners/<id>` has a read-only "Media kit files" card — the partner's folder
  (name, size, updated, Preview link, "Download all") and, collapsed, the generic folder.

'''
s=s.replace(anchor, sec+anchor,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

input.message:
Per-creator media kits are built and committed as `f49d2c996d` on `feature/partner-media-kits`, in the worktree `/tank/dev-worktrees/partner-kits`. Nothing is merged or deployed, and I didn't touch the production DB or send any email. `devhost tsc` is clean, the new unit tests pass 7/7, and all 24 curl checks pass. No permission prompt was denied.

**How it works**
- Each partner sees their own folder `kits/<CODE>/` plus `kits/_generic/`. Codes are checked against `^[A-Z0-9-]{2,20}$`, or must be exactly `_generic`.
- A file can only be served if its name matches an entry in that folder's listing exactly. Symlinks, dotfiles, subfolders, unknown file types, `..` and absolute paths are never listed or served.
- Files are grouped into one video plus its end frame per language. English comes first, labelled English, Turkish, Filipino (Tagalog), Spanish and Hindi.
- `HOW-TO-USE.txt` is parsed into its sections and the raw text stays downloadable. In the generic guide, `YOURCODE` is replaced on screen with the viewer's real code; the downloaded file is unchanged.
- "Download everything" streams a zip of the kit.

**Access rules (per-file route and zip route)**
- Signed out: 401.
- A partner: only their own code's files and `_generic`. Everything else is 404, never 403, as in the existing PDF route.
- Billing-area staff (ADMIN and BILLING): any code. I used the same check as `/admin/partners/<id>` so the admin "Preview" links work for BILLING staff too. Change it to ADMIN-only if you prefer.
- An admin impersonating a partner sees exactly that partner's files.
- Range requests (byte ranges, open-ended, last-N-bytes) return 206, past-the-end returns 416, and `HEAD` works. `?download=1` sends the file as a download; otherwise it opens inline.

**Partner portal and admin**
- The Media kit tab now opens with "Your sponsored segment": a card per language with the player (end frame as poster), Download video and Download end frame, numbered steps, the timestamped narration, the description text with a Copy button, and Download everything.
- Below it is a "Generic English version" block for every partner. When a partner has no personal kit, it shows the line "Your personal version … is on the way".
- `/admin/partners/[id]` has a read-only "Media kit files" card: file names, sizes, updated time, Preview links, Download all, and the generic folder collapsed underneath.

**Testing on node-2** (throwaway DB with ZEROSTER, AIXLL50 and a partner with no kit)
- Curl: signed out gets 401. Another partner's file or zip, a plain customer, a lowercase code, encoded `..`, and an unlisted file all get 404. Staff can read any code. Python's zip check confirmed the downloaded zip's checksums.
- In the browser, the video loaded and seeked to 0:30.
- 1440 and 390 px, dark and light: no horizontal overflow and no page errors.
- One hiccup: the dev server was killed once for running out of memory, during the final round while `tsc` was running too. I restarted it, reran all the checks, and it is now stopped. The node-2 workspace and test DB are removed (`devhost rm`).

**Files**
- New: `lib/partner-kits.ts`, `lib/partner-kit-access.ts`, `lib/partner-kit-urls.ts`, `app/api/creator-partner/kits/[code]/route.ts` (zip), `app/api/creator-partner/kits/[code]/[file]/route.ts`, `components/nx/PartnerMediaKit.tsx`, `test/partner-kits.test.ts`.
- Changed: `app/dashboard/partner/page.tsx`, `components/nx/PartnerView.tsx`, `app/admin/partners/[id]/page.tsx`, `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`.
- Docs: a "Creator media kits" section under the Creator Partner Program section, plus a dated change entry.

**Screenshots and test scripts**
- 13 screenshots, `results.json` and `curl-checks.txt` are in `/root/agent-notes/creator-kits/shots/`: media tab for ZEROSTER and the no-kit partner at 1440/390 in dark/light, AIXLL50 (two languages) at three sizes, and the admin card for both partners.
- The seed, screenshot and curl scripts are in `/root/agent-notes/creator-kits/test-harness/`; none are in the repo.

**Installing in production** (a file copy, no deploy; the folder is read on every page load)
```
install -d -o nxeon -g nxeon -m 0755 /opt/nxeon/partner-files/kits
for d in AIXLL50 HOVEN KOBBI SPY40 WAASEPHI ZEROSTER _generic; do
  install -d -o nxeon -g nxeon -m 0755 /opt/nxeon/partner-files/kits/$d
  install -o nxeon -g nxeon -m 0644 /tank/creator-kits/$d/* /opt/nxeon/partner-files/kits/$d/
done
```
The code has to be deployed before these files show up anywhere.

**Decisions for the owner**
1. **Generic player looks black before play:** `_generic` has no end-frame image, so its player shows a black first frame until it's played. Adding `nxeon-promo_GENERIC_en_16x9_endframe.png` to that folder gives it a poster, with no code change.
2. **Staff access:** confirm BILLING-role staff may fetch any creator's kit (see the access rules above).
3. **Folder names:** the folder name must equal the partner's `ReferralPartner.code` in the DB, in uppercase. Worth checking that the six real codes match the folder names.
